plain_english_policy: Supporting agreements between states to allow residents of one state to purchase health insurance plans from another state’s marketplace, potentially expanding options and competition across borders.

effects.rationale: Promotes cross-state competition in health insurance markets, reducing regulatory barriers to private-sector participation.
Explicitly focuses on private insurers operating across state lines without direct government involvement in plan selection or provision.
May increase consumer choice and availability of insurance options, though actual access depends on implementation (e.g., affordability, pre-existing conditions coverage).

evidence_quote: "Do you support interstate health insurance compacts?"
